```{r ot-detection-defined-propensity, fig.keep='none'}
# The detection CSVs are the authoritative source of category membership and
# original detection P values. No propensity threshold is used for selection.
nm_det_read <- function(candidates) {
  found <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(found)) stop(
    "Detection input not found. Put the supplied detection CSV in the Rmd ",
    "working directory. Searched: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
  )
  readr::read_csv(found[[1]], show_col_types = FALSE)
}

nm_det_score <- function(eligible, metric_names = metric_levels) {
  # Rank against the full eligible insoluble baseline universe (including
  # 'Other' proteins), before extracting selected/reference groups.
  eligible %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(metric_names), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Score") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Score)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sex, Metric) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Percentile = 100 * dplyr::percent_rank(Score)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_names))
}

nm_det_test <- function(scored, pattern, sex, metric, reference = "Stable", n_perm = 1999L) {
  dd <- scored %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sex == sex, as.character(Metric) == metric, Pattern %in% c(pattern, reference)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
  x <- dd$Percentile[dd$Pattern == pattern]
  y <- dd$Percentile[dd$Pattern == reference]
  nc <- length(x); nr <- length(y)
  med_delta <- if (nc && nr) stats::median(x) - stats::median(y) else NA_real_
  auc <- if (nc && nr) mean(vapply(
    x, function(z) mean(as.numeric(z > y) + 0.5 * as.numeric(z == y)), numeric(1)
  )) else NA_real_
  # High-tail enrichment directly tests the 'near the edge' prediction:
  # are selected proteins overrepresented above the sex-specific 75th
  # percentile of the full eligible Old insoluble proteome?
  case_top25 <- sum(x >= 75)
  stable_top25 <- sum(y >= 75)
  fisher_top25 <- if (nc >= 2L && nr >= 2L) {
    tryCatch(stats::fisher.test(
      matrix(c(case_top25, nc - case_top25, stable_top25, nr - stable_top25), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      alternative = "greater")$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else NA_real_
  p_w <- if (nc >= 2L && nr >= 2L) {
    tryCatch(stats::wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)$p.value,
             error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else NA_real_

  # Sensitivity analysis: shuffle membership *within cellular components*.
  # Only components containing at least one case and one reference can inform
  # a within-component comparison. The permutation holds observed group counts
  # fixed in every component and uses the one-sided high-propensity alternative.
  overlapping <- dd %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Bin) %>%
    dplyr::filter(any(Pattern == pattern), any(Pattern == reference)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  n_case_overlap <- sum(overlapping$Pattern == pattern)
  n_ref_overlap <- sum(overlapping$Pattern == reference)
  observed <- if (n_case_overlap >= 2L && n_ref_overlap >= 2L) {
    mean(overlapping$Percentile[overlapping$Pattern == pattern]) -
      mean(overlapping$Percentile[overlapping$Pattern == reference])
  } else NA_real_
  p_strat <- NA_real_
  if (is.finite(observed) && n_perm >= 99L) {
    # Reproducible, independent of plot rendering or other analysis chunks.
    set.seed(1807L + match(sex, c("Female", "Male")) * 101L + match(metric, metric_levels) * 13L + nchar(pattern))
    by_bin <- split(seq_len(nrow(overlapping)), as.character(overlapping$Bin))
    case_n <- vapply(by_bin, function(idx) sum(overlapping$Pattern[idx] == pattern), integer(1))
    perm_effect <- replicate(n_perm, {
      is_case <- rep(FALSE, nrow(overlapping))
      for (b in names(by_bin)) {
        idx <- by_bin[[b]]
        is_case[sample(idx, size = case_n[[b]], replace = FALSE)] <- TRUE
      }
      mean(overlapping$Percentile[is_case]) -
        mean(overlapping$Percentile[!is_case])
    })
    p_strat <- (1 + sum(perm_effect >= observed - 1e-12)) / (n_perm + 1)
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    Sex = sex, Pattern = pattern, Metric = metric,
    n_selected = nc, n_stable = nr,
    median_percentile_selected = if (nc) stats::median(x) else NA_real_,
    median_percentile_stable = if (nr) stats::median(y) else NA_real_,
    median_difference_pp = med_delta,
    AUC_probability_selected_higher = auc,
    n_selected_top_quartile = case_top25,
    n_stable_top_quartile = stable_top25,
    p_Fisher_top_quartile_one_sided = fisher_top25,
    p_Wilcoxon_one_sided = p_w,
    n_case_within_bin = n_case_overlap,
    n_stable_within_bin = n_ref_overlap,
    delta_mean_pp_within_overlap_bins = observed,
    p_permutation_within_bin_one_sided = p_strat
  )
}

nm_det_test_all <- function(scored, patterns) {
  test_grid <- tidyr::crossing(Sex = c("Female", "Male"), Pattern = patterns, Metric = metric_levels)
  purrr::pmap_dfr(test_grid, function(Sex, Pattern, Metric) {
    nm_det_test(scored, as.character(Pattern), as.character(Sex), as.character(Metric))
  }) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sex) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # AO: 3 tests/sex. OT: 9 tests/sex, across 3 categories x 3 metrics.
      FDR_Wilcoxon_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_Wilcoxon_one_sided, "BH"),
      FDR_top_quartile_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_Fisher_top_quartile_one_sided, "BH"),
      FDR_within_bin_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_permutation_within_bin_one_sided, "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

# Component palette shares the same GO assignment/viridis generation as
# the primary OT and AO propensity figures.
nm_ot_detect_component_cols <- c(component_cols[!is.na(component_cols)], "Other/Unassigned" = "#7A7A7A")

nm_ot_detect_shapes <- c(
  "Na4vSS" = 21,   # circle
  "TANGO" = 24,    # triangle
  "WALTZ %" = 22  # square
)

nm_ot_detect_short <- c(
  "Stable" = "Stable",
  "Shared loss" = "Shared",
  "Exercise-specific" = "Exercise",
  "Rapamycin-specific" = "Rapamycin"
)

nm_fmt_p <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(is.na(x) ~ "NA", x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", x))
}

nm_ot_detect_stat_strip <- function(test_df, patterns) {

  panels <- c(
    "Female — Na4vSS", "Female — TANGO", "Female — WALTZ %",
    "Male — Na4vSS", "Male — TANGO", "Male — WALTZ %"
  )

  labels <- stats::setNames(paste0("<b>", panels, "</b>"), panels)

  if (is.null(test_df)) return(labels)

  fmt <- function(x) {
    gsub("<", "&lt;", nm_fmt_p(x), fixed = TRUE)
  }

  # Fixed category order and abbreviated labels
  pattern_order <- c("Shared loss", "Exercise-specific", "Rapamycin-specific")

  short <- c("Shared loss" = "Shared", "Exercise-specific" = "Ex", "Rapamycin-specific" = "Rapa")

  tab <- test_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(Pattern) %in% patterns) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(match(as.character(Pattern), pattern_order))

  for (sex in c("Female", "Male")) {
    for (metric in c("Na4vSS", "TANGO", "WALTZ %")) {

      key <- paste(sex, metric, sep = " — ")

      dat <- tab %>%
        dplyr::filter(Sex == sex, as.character(Metric) == metric)

      if (!nrow(dat)) next

      lines <- character()

      for (j in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {

        z <- dat[j, ]
        prefix <- unname(short[as.character(z$Pattern)])

        lines <- c(
          lines,
          paste0(
            "<b>", prefix, ":</b> ",
            "Wilcoxon p = ", fmt(z$p_Wilcoxon_one_sided),
            ", q = ", fmt(z$FDR_Wilcoxon_BH),
            " | Fisher p = ",
            fmt(z$p_Fisher_top_quartile_one_sided),
            ", q = ", fmt(z$FDR_top_quartile_BH)
          )
        )
      }

      # One compact line per category
      stat_size <- "5.0pt"

      labels[[key]] <- paste0(
        "<span style='font-size:7pt;'><b>",
        key,
        "</b></span>",
        paste0("<br><span style='font-size:", stat_size, ";'>", lines, "</span>", collapse = "")
      )
    }
  }

  labels
}

nm_ot_detect_distribution <- function(scored, patterns, chart_title,
                                      component_cols, tests_df = NULL,
                                      show_detection_sig = FALSE) {
  lev <- c("Stable", patterns)
  dd <- scored %>%
    dplyr::filter(Pattern %in% lev) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pattern = factor(Pattern, levels = lev),
      Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
      Bin = factor(Bin, levels = names(component_cols)),
      Label = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", Protein_ID, Gene),
      SigStatus = dplyr::if_else(Sig_Selected %in% TRUE, "Nominal p ≤ 0.05", "NS"),
      Panel = factor(paste0(Sex, " — ", Metric),
                     levels = c("Female — Na4vSS", "Female — TANGO", "Female — WALTZ %",
                                "Male — Na4vSS", "Male — TANGO", "Male — WALTZ %"))
    )
  stable_df <- dd %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern == "Stable")
  selected_df <- dd %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern != "Stable")
  sig_df <- selected_df %>% dplyr::filter(SigStatus == "Nominal p ≤ 0.05")
  ns_df <- selected_df %>% dplyr::filter(SigStatus == "NS")
  label_df <- selected_df %>% dplyr::filter(Percentile > 75)
  strip_labels <- nm_ot_detect_stat_strip(tests_df, patterns)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      data = stable_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile),
      width = 0.55, alpha = 0.22, outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.25, color = "#979797", fill = "#D0D0D0"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      data = selected_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile),
      width = 0.55, alpha = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.25, color = "#696969", fill = "#A5A5A5"
    )

  if (show_detection_sig) {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = ns_df,
        ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, color = Bin, shape = SigStatus),
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.10, height = 0, seed = 2407),
        size = 1.28, alpha = 0.90, stroke = 0.35
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = sig_df,
        ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, color = Bin, shape = SigStatus),
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.10, height = 0, seed = 2407),
        size = 1.28, alpha = 0.90, stroke = 0.35
      )
  } else {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = selected_df,
        ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, color = Bin),
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.10, height = 0, seed = 2407),
        size = 1.12, alpha = 0.90
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, label = Label, color = Bin),
      size = 2.0,
      direction = "both",
      box.padding = 0.18,
      point.padding = 0.10,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.size = 0.16,
      segment.alpha = 0.8,
      force = 2.0,
      force_pull = 0.15,
      max.time = 2,
      seed = 2407,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Panel, ncol = 3, drop = FALSE, labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(strip_labels)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.18, color = "grey65") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = component_cols,
                                drop = FALSE, na.value = "#7A7A7A",
                                name = "Cellular component") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = nm_ot_detect_short, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
                                limits = c(0, 100),
                                expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.025))) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = chart_title,
      subtitle = if (show_detection_sig) {
        ">75th percentile selected proteins are labeled; open points = NS, filled points = nominal detection P ≤ 0.05"
      } else {
        "Selected proteins above the 75th percentile labeled; colors = cellular component"
      },
      x = NULL, y = "Intrinsic aggregation score percentile"
    ) +
    theme_nm(legend_position = "right") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
        size = 7, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 1.12,
        family = nm_style$font_family,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0.9, b = 0.9, unit = "mm")
      )
    )

  if (show_detection_sig) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("NS" = 1, "Nominal p ≤ 0.05" = 16), name = "Detection test")
  }

  p
}

nm_ot_detect_protein_plot <- function(scored, selected_pattern, selected_sex, metric_shapes, component_cols) {
  dd <- scored %>%
    dplyr::filter(Pattern == selected_pattern, Sex == selected_sex) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Label = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", Protein_ID, Gene),
      Bin = factor(Bin, levels = names(component_cols)),
      BinColor = dplyr::coalesce(unname(component_cols[as.character(Bin)]), "#7A7A7A")
    )
  if (!nrow(dd)) {
    # An explicit empty figure is preferable to silent omission for a
    # significant-only sex/category with zero scored detection candidates.
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
          label = "No selected proteins\nwith available propensity scores",
          size = 2.4, color = "#555555"
        ) +
        ggplot2::xlim(0, 1) + ggplot2::ylim(0, 1) +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste(selected_pattern, "—", selected_sex)) +
        ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 7) +
        ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
    )
  }
  order_genes <- dd %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Protein_ID, Label, Bin, BinColor) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Average = mean(Percentile), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Average, Label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      UniqueLabel = make.unique(as.character(Label)),
      LabelMarkdown = paste0("<span style='color:", BinColor, ";'>", UniqueLabel, "</span>")
    )
  dd <- dd %>%
    dplyr::left_join(order_genes %>% dplyr::select(Protein_ID, UniqueLabel, Bin), by = c("Protein_ID", "Bin")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(UniqueLabel = factor(UniqueLabel, levels = order_genes$UniqueLabel))
  label_map <- stats::setNames(order_genes$LabelMarkdown, order_genes$UniqueLabel)

  ggplot2::ggplot(dd, ggplot2::aes(x = Percentile, y = UniqueLabel)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(shape = Metric, color = Bin, fill = Bin),
      position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.12, seed = 108),
      size = 2.0, stroke = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = metric_shapes, drop = FALSE, name = "Aggregation metric") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = component_cols, name = "Cellular component",
      drop = FALSE, na.value = "#7A7A7A"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = scales::alpha(component_cols, 0.35), guide = "none",
      drop = FALSE, na.value = scales::alpha("#7A7A7A", 0.35)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Aggregation score percentile", y = NULL,
      title = paste(selected_pattern, "—", selected_sex),
      subtitle = "Protein names/colors = component; marker shapes = propensity metric"
    ) +
    theme_nm(legend_position = "right") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.15),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(
        family = nm_style$font_family, size = nm_style$axis_text,
        colour = "black"
      )
    )
}
# INPUT: Original detection-analysis CSVs (must be in Rmd working folder).
# IMPORTANT: raw P < 0.05 identifies nominally significant detection changes;
# no file contains FDR-significant selected proteins at FDR < 0.05.
ot_input_specs <- list(
  "Shared loss" = "Detect_SharedLoss_bySex.csv",
  "Exercise-specific" = "Detect_ExSpecific_bySex.csv",
  "Rapamycin-specific" = "Detect_RapaSpecific_bySex.csv"
)

ot_detection_selected <- purrr::imap_dfr(ot_input_specs, function(input, pattern) {
  csv <- nm_det_read(input)
  # Prevent reinterpreting an original detection category from today's raw
  # proteomics matrix or from the presence of a propensity score.
  required_cols <- c("Protein.Group", "Gene1", "Bin", "Sex",
                     "detected_n_Control", "detected_n_Exercise",
                     "detected_n_Rapamycin", "p_Exercise", "p_Rapamycin",
                     "FDR_Exercise", "FDR_Rapamycin")
  absent <- setdiff(required_cols, names(csv))
  if (length(absent)) stop("Columns missing in ", input, ": ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
  csv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sex = as.character(Sex), Protein_ID = clean_id(Protein.Group),
      Pattern = pattern,
      CSV_Gene = as.character(Gene1), CSV_Bin = as.character(Bin),
      CSV_Control_N = as.integer(detected_n_Control),
      CSV_Exercise_N = as.integer(detected_n_Exercise),
      CSV_Rapamycin_N = as.integer(detected_n_Rapamycin),
      CSV_p_Exercise = as.numeric(p_Exercise),
      CSV_p_Rapamycin = as.numeric(p_Rapamycin),
      CSV_FDR_Exercise = as.numeric(FDR_Exercise),
      CSV_FDR_Rapamycin = as.numeric(FDR_Rapamycin),
      Sig_Exercise = is.finite(CSV_p_Exercise) & CSV_p_Exercise < 0.05,
      Sig_Rapamycin = is.finite(CSV_p_Rapamycin) & CSV_p_Rapamycin < 0.05,
      Sig_Both = Sig_Exercise & Sig_Rapamycin,
      Sig_Selected = dplyr::case_when(
        Pattern == "Shared loss" ~ (Sig_Exercise | Sig_Rapamycin),
        Pattern == "Exercise-specific" ~ Sig_Exercise,
        Pattern == "Rapamycin-specific" ~ Sig_Rapamycin,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    )
}) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sex, Protein_ID, Pattern, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (any(duplicated(ot_detection_selected[c("Sex", "Protein_ID")]))) {
  stop("A protein occurs in more than one loss category within a sex. ",
       "Check the original detection CSVs before testing.")
}

# Recalculate sex-specific raw detection counts for QC and stable references,
# but DO NOT use these to redefine category membership from the original CSVs.
ot_det_counts <- ins_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Age == "Old", Sex %in% c("Female", "Male")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Protein_ID = clean_id(Protein.Group)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sex, Protein_ID, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(N = max(0L, max(
    vapply(split(Detected, Protein.Group), function(z) sum(z, na.rm = TRUE), integer(1)), na.rm = TRUE
  )), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = N, names_prefix = "N_", values_fill = 0L)
for (nm in c("N_Control", "N_Exercise", "N_Rapamycin")) {
  if (!nm %in% names(ot_det_counts)) ot_det_counts[[nm]] <- 0L
}

ot_annotations <- ins_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Protein_ID = clean_id(Protein.Group)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Protein_ID, Gene1, Bin) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene = Gene1)

ot_det_base <- ot_det_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Control >= min_detected) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ot_annotations, by = "Protein_ID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ot_detection_selected, by = c("Sex", "Protein_ID")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = dplyr::coalesce(CSV_Gene, Gene, Protein_ID),
    Bin = dplyr::coalesce(CSV_Bin, as.character(Bin), "Other/Unassigned"),
    Stable = N_Exercise >= min_detected & N_Rapamycin >= min_detected,
    Selected_All = !is.na(Pattern),
    Selected_Sig = Selected_All & Sig_Selected %in% TRUE,
    Pattern = dplyr::case_when(Selected_All ~ Pattern, Stable ~ "Stable", TRUE ~ "Other")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metrics_wide, by = "Protein_ID") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sex, Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Input audit includes EVERY original protein/sex/category, even if a protein
# cannot be scored or cannot be reconstructed in the current raw matrix.
ot_det_audit <- ot_detection_selected %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ot_det_counts, by = c("Sex", "Protein_ID")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metrics_wide, by = "Protein_ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Has_Control_Min2 = !is.na(N_Control) & N_Control >= min_detected,
    Reproduces_Detection_Counts =
      !is.na(N_Control) & N_Control == CSV_Control_N &
      !is.na(N_Exercise) & N_Exercise == CSV_Exercise_N &
      !is.na(N_Rapamycin) & N_Rapamycin == CSV_Rapamycin_N,
    Has_Na4vSS = is.finite(Na4vSS),
    Has_TANGO = is.finite(TANGO),
    Has_WALTZ = is.finite(`WALTZ %`),
    Has_All_3_Scores = Has_Na4vSS & Has_TANGO & Has_WALTZ,
    Score_Coverage = paste0(
      ifelse(Has_Na4vSS, "Na4vSS ", ""),
      ifelse(Has_TANGO, "TANGO ", ""),
      ifelse(Has_WALTZ, "WALTZ", "")
    ),
    In_Analysis_Universe = Has_Control_Min2
  )
if (any(!ot_det_audit$Has_Control_Min2)) {
  warning("Selected detection-CSV entries not found with >=2 Old-Control ",
          "insoluble detections in current raw data. See OT_Detect_Input_QC.csv.")
}
if (any(!ot_det_audit$Reproduces_Detection_Counts)) {
  warning("Some detection counts differ from the original CSVs. ",
          "See OT_Detect_Input_QC.csv (original category assignments retained).")
}

ot_det_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "DetectionProp")
dir.create(ot_det_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(ot_det_audit, file.path(ot_det_dir, "OT_Detect_Input_QC.csv"))
readr::write_csv(ot_detection_selected, file.path(ot_det_dir, "OT_Detect_OriginalCandidates.csv"))
readr::write_csv(ot_det_base %>% dplyr::filter(Selected_All),
                 file.path(ot_det_dir, "OT_Detect_Selected_ProteinScores.csv"))

# Calculate percentile ONCE on the full sex-specific Old-Control insoluble
# universe, before filtering the significant-only subset.
ot_det_scored_base <- nm_det_score(ot_det_base)

nm_ot_det_subset <- function(scored, significant_only = FALSE) {
  selected <- if (significant_only) scored$Selected_Sig else scored$Selected_All
  scored %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pattern = dplyr::case_when(
        selected ~ as.character(Pattern),
        Selected_All ~ "Other",  # nonsignificant loss never joins stable reference
        Stable ~ "Stable",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
}

ot_det_scored_all <- nm_ot_det_subset(ot_det_scored_base, FALSE)
ot_det_scored_sig <- nm_ot_det_subset(ot_det_scored_base, TRUE)

# Because subset() is row-wise, unsignificant loss proteins revert to Other,
# NOT Stable. This prevents contaminating the comparison/reference group.
ot_det_patterns <- names(ot_input_specs)

nm_ot_det_export_subset <- function(scored, tag) {
  readr::write_csv(
    scored %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern %in% c("Stable", ot_det_patterns)),
    file.path(ot_det_dir, paste0("OT_Detect_MetricPercentiles_", tag, ".csv"))
  )
  tests <- nm_det_test_all(scored, ot_det_patterns) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Subset = tag)
  readr::write_csv(tests, file.path(ot_det_dir, paste0("OT_Detect_Tests_", tag, ".csv")))
  tests
}

ot_det_tests_all <- nm_ot_det_export_subset(ot_det_scored_all, "All")
ot_det_tests_sig <- nm_ot_det_export_subset(ot_det_scored_sig, "Sig")
print(ot_det_tests_all)
print(ot_det_tests_sig)

# Coverage table shows selection numbers before/after accession matching,
# control-detection gate and finite metric-score availability.
ot_det_coverage <- tidyr::crossing(
  Sex = c("Female", "Male"),
  Pattern = ot_det_patterns,
  Subset = c("All", "Sig"),
  Metric = metric_levels
) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_csv_candidates = sum(
      ot_det_audit$Sex == Sex & ot_det_audit$Pattern == Pattern &
        (Subset == "All" | ot_det_audit$Sig_Selected %in% TRUE)
    ),
    n_matched_old_control = sum(
      ot_det_audit$Sex == Sex & ot_det_audit$Pattern == Pattern &
        (Subset == "All" | ot_det_audit$Sig_Selected %in% TRUE) &
        ot_det_audit$Has_Control_Min2
    ),
    n_finite_score = sum(
      (if (Subset == "All") {
        ot_det_scored_all
      } else {
        ot_det_scored_sig
      })$Sex == Sex &
        (if (Subset == "All") {
          ot_det_scored_all
        } else {
          ot_det_scored_sig
        })$Pattern == Pattern &
        as.character((if (Subset == "All") {
          ot_det_scored_all
        } else {
          ot_det_scored_sig
        })$Metric) == Metric
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
readr::write_csv(ot_det_coverage, file.path(ot_det_dir, "OT_Detect_ScoreCoverage.csv"))

# Combined plots retain all three categories. Individual-category plots make
# selected >75th-percentile labels easier to place and read in small panels.
for (subset_tag in c("All", "Sig")) {
  dsub <- if (subset_tag == "All") ot_det_scored_all else ot_det_scored_sig
  suffix <- if (subset_tag == "All") "" else "_Sig"
  p_comb <- nm_ot_detect_distribution(
    dsub, ot_det_patterns,
    paste0("Insoluble detection loss and aggregation propensity",
           if (subset_tag == "Sig") " (nominally significant detection)" else ""),
    nm_ot_detect_component_cols,
    tests_df = if (subset_tag == "All") ot_det_tests_all else ot_det_tests_sig,
    show_detection_sig = (subset_tag == "All")
  )
  save_nm_both(
    p_comb,
    file.path(ot_det_dir, paste0("OT_Detect_Propensity", suffix)),
    "corr_both", save_legend = TRUE
  )

  for (pattern in ot_det_patterns) {
    short <- switch(
      pattern,
      "Shared loss" = "Shared", "Exercise-specific" = "Exercise",
      "Rapamycin-specific" = "Rapa"
    )
    p_comp <- nm_ot_detect_distribution(
      dsub, pattern,
      paste0(pattern, ": aggregation propensity",
             if (subset_tag == "Sig") " (nominal detection P < 0.05)" else ""),
      nm_ot_detect_component_cols,
      tests_df = if (subset_tag == "All") ot_det_tests_all else ot_det_tests_sig,
      show_detection_sig = (subset_tag == "All")
    )
    save_nm_both(
      p_comp,
      file.path(ot_det_dir, paste0("OT_Detect_Prop_", short, suffix)),
      "corr_both", save_legend = TRUE
    )

    for (sx in c("Female", "Male")) {
      dd <- dsub %>%
        dplyr::filter(Pattern == pattern, Sex == sx)
      p_prot <- nm_ot_detect_protein_plot(dsub, pattern, sx, nm_ot_detect_shapes, nm_ot_detect_component_cols)
      id <- paste0("OT_Detect_", short, "_", sx, suffix)
      save_nm_both(p_prot, file.path(ot_det_dir, id), "shift_sex", save_legend = nrow(dd) > 0)
    }
  }
}
```

**Interpretation:** Increased intrinsic aggregation propensity among proteins
whose insoluble detection decreases after Exercise and/or Rapamycin would be
consistent with interventions affecting proteins close to their solubility
threshold. However, a reduction in mass-spectrometric detection does not
establish protein solubilization or aggregate clearance: decreased abundance,
turnover, extraction efficiency and detection limits remain alternative
explanations. Component-stratified permutations are sensitivity tests, not
full control for baseline protein abundance. In particular, nominally
significant detection subsets with fewer than two scored proteins have
**no inferential Wilcoxon/Fisher P value** (reported as `NA`), even though their
individual scores are still plotted.

```{r output-summary}
cat(
  "\nUpdated old-treatment aggregation-propensity analysis complete (v17 pooled-sex baseline).\n",
  "Output directory: ", normalizePath(out_dir, mustWork = TRUE), "\n\n",
  "Primary comparisons:\n",
  "  Exercise vs Control\n",
  "  Rapamycin vs Control\n",
  "No three-treatment omnibus test is used as a prerequisite for these comparisons.\n\n",
  "Baseline universe: Old-Control insoluble proteome; >=2 detections TOTAL across sexes.\n",
  "Sex does not determine baseline entry; sex-specific treatment effects require >=2 valid Control and treatment observations within sex.\n",
  "Primary endpoint: volume-corrected treatment effect on log2(Insoluble/Soluble).\n",
  "Secondary endpoint: treatment effect on insoluble abundance.\n",
  "All manuscript figures are exported as 600-dpi PNG and editable SVG files; ggplot legends are exported separately when present.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Export manifest / panel lookup

Once the analysis has produced the figures, inspect `list_panels()` to find each
figure ID, the plotting chunk, and its current physical dimensions. To re-export
only a figure, change its named dimension entry in the Figure export settings and run
`reexport("Panel_ID")`. The following chunk writes a short output manifest.

```{r nm-export-manifest}
figure_export_manifest()
```
